subject: Competitive bake-off recap: Redwood vs. BigCloudAI & ModelHub
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme.com>, Rahul Shah <rahul.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (competitive bake-off)

Hi Sophie / Rahul —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Acme's evaluation criteria and run through Redwood's demo. Quick recap from our side so we have alignment and a clear list of next steps.

Summary of pain & goals:
- Current pain: model endpoints are inconsistent across teams, unpredictable latency at 95th percentile, and high per-token costs on the current provider (BigCloudAI).
- Primary goals: predictable sub-200ms tail latency for short-chat flows, lower cost-per-1k tokens by at least 20%, and single-pane observability for routing and rollouts across regions.
- Compliance note: need support for customer-managed KMS and audit logs for SOC 2 evidence.

Competitive landscape (as discussed):
- BigCloudAI: strong turnkey ML integrations, but observed 95th latency spikes and limited fallback options; higher cost at current throughput.
- ModelHub (open model infra): flexible and low-cost on paper but requires significant infra ops and custom kernel tuning; longer time to production.
- Redwood: unified runtime (hosted/dedicated/private), automated prefix caching and smart routing, and options for Dedicated or Private deployments to meet isolation/SLA needs.

Decision criteria we heard you emphasize:
1) Tail latency and SLO guarantees
2) Total cost of ownership (tokens, infra, ops)
3) Ease of integration with existing infra and security controls (KMS/HSM, VPC)
4) Runbook for fallbacks and canary rollouts

Open questions we captured:
- Can Redwood demonstrate sustained 95th-latency <200ms for 4k-context chat on similar workloads? (ACME test 1)
- Cost modelling: a comparative cost projection for your typical qps (we'll provide a side-by-side estimate).
- Data residency: plan for EU region support if pilot expands.

Proposed follow-up tests (we suggested):
- ACME test 1: 2-day synthetic workload replay of chat flows (short sessions) to measure tail latency and failure modes.
- ACME test 2: 1-day large-batch embedding throughput to validate throughput and cost.
- Integration smoke test: canary route + KV cache warmup using a subset of prod traffic.

Attachments: I've attached a short bake-off summary (PDF) and a draft test-plan (xlsx) with proposed metrics and success thresholds. I'll also share the demo recording.

Next steps / owners:
- Redwood to schedule and run ACME test 1: Dev Patel will run the workload with your test data — target window: Aug 17–18. (owner: Dev)
- Redwood to provide cost projection and sample config (Marissa) — ETA: Aug 13.
- Acme to confirm procurement constraints and any redlines for Private deployment (Rahul / procurement).
- Follow-up sync after tests to review evidence and discuss Dedicated vs Private path.

If that aligns, I'll send calendar invites for the test window and a 30-min review for Aug 19.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Sophie / Rahul —

Thanks for the note — quick technical answers and plan from my side:

- KMS: Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS when deployed in a VPC with our Private control plane; for hosted Dedicated pools we can integrate with customer KMS in select regions — I will validate whether your requested AWS account/region is supported and confirm by Aug 13.
- Testing: attached is a draft test-plan.xlsx with exact metrics we propose to gather (95th/99th latency, p99 CPU/GPU utilization, token cost estimate, error rate). We'll need your replay S3 location and an IAM role with read access.
- Re: sustained <200ms 95th for 4k-context: that performance target is aggressive at 4k on current gen models but achievable with appropriate batching and our prefix/KV caching; we'll run the replay with the same sequence distribution and report exact numbers.

I'll coordinate infra setup and share a runbook for the Aug 17 start.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
